name: DPM4 final demo · cafeteria app · Task 2 by 65 s of silence (the Moderator picks the angle from the agents' topic labels)
goal: Propose an app that helps students choose where to eat on campus

steps.title: Opening · the team brainstorms. Expected: no agreement check.
steps.text: We need an idea for tonight's proposal. What about putting all the campus cafeteria menus in one place? I always have to check each one separately.
I'd use that. I usually check the menus right before class ends.
We could put the prices next to the menus, too.

steps.title: TASK 1 · Taeho thinks with his agent. Expected: a private reply; nothing reaches the team.
steps.text: Menus and prices are useful, but sometimes I like both options. What else would help me pick?
Yeah, if both lunches are around the same price, I'd still be standing outside class trying to pick one.
A shorter line would decide it for me. Yesterday the line was out the door at noon, but at 12:30 I walked right in. Could we show when each cafeteria usually gets busy?

steps.title: TASK 2 · the chat is quiet for 65 s. Expected: Taeho's agent reports a topic label, the Moderator picks an angle that covers it, and only Taeho gets a share card.

steps.fallback: What about putting wait times next to the menus? If both places have something I like, I'd go for the shorter line.

steps.title: TASK 3 · Minsu posts the sentence to submit. Expected: an agreement check about what 'wait times' means.
steps.text: Okay, I think we've got our idea. Let's put this in tonight's proposal: Students can compare campus cafeteria menus, prices, and wait times to decide where to eat.
Does 'wait times' sound like we'd show how long the line is right now?
Quick check before we submit. Are we promising live wait times, or the usual wait at that time of day?

steps.title: The team talks it through. Expected: individual views do not reopen the check; Minsu's adoption opens version 2.
steps.text: Oh, I was picturing a live estimate.
I meant the usual wait. We could collect that ourselves, but I'm not sure how we'd keep a live estimate updated.
The usual wait would be enough for me. I'd just want to know if noon is a bad time to go.
Okay, let's go with typical wait times by day and time.
